With GenStone, you can have the look of stone or brick without the mortar and mess. More importantly, we’ve engineered the labor out of the install, so GenStone is DIY friendly and costs about 50% less than masonry work. GenStone fastens to any existing flat surface including wood, brick, stucco, concrete and drywall. There’s no need to remove any existing material.
